implemented_findings.FIN-001: Shared net-after-storno capacity in bank writes, reconciliation previews/summaries, client invoice views and financial exports. Excess bank allocation is refused; manual overpayment requires explicit confirmation.
implemented_findings.FIN-002: Generic receivable cancellation atomically synchronizes invoice, linked unused credit and bank state. Consumed credit blocks reversal. Bank-origin corrections require controlled reversal and reallocation.
implemented_findings.FIN-003: Stable per-intent UI keys in receivables, legacy client invoices and bank reconciliation; server fingerprints bind immutable intent. API request keys are required. Persisted payment lookup supports unknown-result recovery.
implemented_findings.FIN-004: Default export uses canonical current registry including older confirmed imports; explicit snapshot mode remains available. Adjustment, adjusted gross and canonical outstanding are exported separately.
implemented_findings.FIN-005: Live internal billing-plan generator, paginated work queue, responsibility/status and fiscal-document linkage. Generation is explicit, atomic and repeatable; linked history is protected from changed terms or periods.
implemented_findings.FIN-006: Outstanding-debt lifetime is independent of reminder cadence; all deterministic pages are visited, including debts older than 90 days. A call does not settle debt, and manual resolution is blocked while canonical outstanding remains.
implemented_findings.FIN-007: Explicit net/VAT/gross invoice allocations across campaigns with optional reservation/location/billing links; sourced draft/approved costs; currency/entity separation; margin is unavailable until current full-period cost coverage is human confirmed and fiscal consistency holds.
implemented_findings.FIN-009: Summary groups persisted shares before prorating and billing distributes partial-period rounding residuals deterministically. Reservation allocation itself is owned by the reservation implementation lane.
